turns.q: If they want to exchange it, how would that work?
turns.replyTail:
IF THEY WANT TO EXCHANGE IT, HOW WOULD THAT WORK?
If the gift doesn’t fit, they can request a size or color exchange within 14 DAYS OF RECEIVING IT through our RETURN PORTAL. They’ll need the order details from your confirmation email. In the portal, select “ITEM DID NOT FIT,” then “REPLACE WITH SAME ITEM” to see the available sizes or colors.
Keep the item unworn, with tags attached and in its original packaging. The portal will show which replacements are available.
